title: Hello, I'm BadCode
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Hello, I'm BadCode

beats.name: A. Hello
beats.blurb: Something warm and happy on screen. Voice: "Hello. I'm from the future."

beats.name: B. It didn't go well
beats.blurb: Cut to BadCode, the masked figure, deadpan: "It didn't go well."

beats.name: C. The horror reel
beats.blurb: Real footage of AI data centres and the bad things happening now, flashing in a horror compilation with cinematic music.

beats.name: D. Here's what to do
beats.blurb: The music slows to nothing. "Here's what to do next." Then the BadCode logo. No other words.
